name: CerraData-4MM
description: The Cerrado faces increasing environmental pressures, necessitating accurate land use and land cover (LULC) mapping despite challenges such as class imbalance and visually similar categories. To address this, we present CerraData-4MM, a multimodal dataset combining Sentinel-1 Synthetic Aperture Radar (SAR) and Sentinel-2 MultiSpectral Imagery (MSI) with 10m spatial resolution. The dataset includes two hierarchical classification levels with 7 and 14 classes, respectively, focusing on the diverse Bico do Papagaio ecoregion. We highlight CerraData-4MM's capacity to benchmark advanced semantic segmentation techniques by evaluating a standard U-Net and a more sophisticated Vision Transformer (ViT) model. The ViT achieves superior performance in multimodal scenarios, with the highest macro F1-score of 57.60% and a mean Intersection over Union (mIoU) of 49.05% at the first hierarchical level. Both models struggle with minority classes, particularly at the second hierarchical level, where U-Net's performance drops to an F1-score of 18.16%. Class balancing improves representation for underrepresented classes but reduces overall accuracy, underscoring the trade-off in weighted training. CerraData-4MM offers a challenging benchmark for advancing deep learning models to handle class imbalance and multimodal data fusion. Code, trained models, and data are publicly available at https://github.com/ai4luc/CerraData-4MM.
evaluation_method: macro F1 / mean Intersection over Union (mIoU)
reputation: A recent, region-specific multimodal remote-sensing benchmark cited by researchers working on LULC mapping and multimodal fusion methods.
notes: Non-LLM benchmark focused on remote sensing; strong class imbalance and region-specific labels can limit generalization. Dataset size and regional scope may constrain broad applicability; reported results indicate minority-class performance remains poor.
